Re: Account ID: ACC-630538

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the account referenced above. We understand that you have disputed the account as "not mine." We will investigate this dispute in accordance with the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA) and Nevada state law.

Pursuant to the FDCPA, we are required to provide you with a written validation of the debt. However, you have not requested validation of the debt, and we will not provide it at this time. Our records indicate that the original creditor is First National Bank, and the account was charged off on January 11, 2022. Your last payment on this account was made on July 30, 2024, with a current balance of $2,173.45.

Regarding your concerns about communication from our agency, we will review our communication practices to ensure compliance with the FDCPA and state law. However, we cannot address your allegations of harassment or unprofessional conduct as these are not directly related to the account dispute.

We will investigate your dispute and provide a response within the timeframes required by law. If our investigation confirms that the account is not yours, we will take steps to remove the account from our records and notify the credit bureaus accordingly.

You have the right to dispute this account further if you believe additional information is necessary to resolve the matter. Please contact us at your earliest convenience to discuss this further.

Sincerely,

Keystone Account Solutions
